name: Justice Consumer Law
verdict: With zero spend, leads, or clicks across Meta and Google Ads in the last 28 days, paid channels are completely inactive, making GBP the sole source of engagement at 150 total actions (49 calls, 101 web clicks). The biggest movement is a sharp 87.5% drop in GBP activity over the last 7 days, likely signaling a sudden loss of local search visibility or a profile issue that needs immediate investigation.

performance.verdict: Paid channels dead 28 days; GBP collapse confirms organic also failing now.

findings.text: All paid spend is $0 for all 28 days in the series — Meta and Google Ads are completely inactive, generating zero leads.
GBP actions collapsed 87.5% last 7 days; last 3 days (Aug 25–27) show 0 actions vs. avg 5.3/day prior 3 days — confirmed drop, not noise.
Search clicks (sc) rose 37.7% 7d and hit 43 on Aug 25 and Aug 26 — organic search intent exists but no paid channel is capturing it.
GHL shows 23 contacts and 0 opportunities created in 28 days with zero paid leads — pipeline is inert; no intake leak, no ads to leak from.

suggestions.text: Investigate and restore GBP profile immediately — 0 actions for 3 consecutive days is a confirmed visibility loss.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for Aug 25–27 after averaging 5+ actions/day the prior week — an 87.5% 7-day drop confirmed in the series. Check for a suspended profile, unverified edits, or a category change that triggered a demotion. Success check: GBP actions return to ≥5/day within 7 days. Re-check by 2026-09-04.

suggestions.text: Watch for contract extension confirmation with Marwan — no paid reactivation until engagement is reinstated.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta and Google Ads have been at $0 spend for all 28 days in the data window. The SOW notes the June extension has lapsed and a new extension with Marwan is open and gates the next 3 months. No budget reactivation should occur until the contract is confirmed. Re-check status by 2026-09-04.

suggestions.text: Watch sc_clicks: 43/day on Aug 25–26 signals demand; be ready to reactivate Meta at $65/day on contract confirmation.
suggestions.monday_update: Search clicks hit 43 on both Aug 25 and Aug 26, the highest in the 45-day series, confirming market demand is present despite paid channels being dark. The previously proven Meta CROA campaign structure (75/day, 3 leads/day target in July) should be staged and ready. If Marwan confirms the extension, reactivate at $65/day and confirm lead form-to-GHL connections before launch. Re-check by 2026-09-04.
